nodes.description: Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal sale-gating check: whitelists owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale and otherwise calls condition.
Public payable transferFrom: spends allowance, calls ensure, then mutates balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits per sender.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-controlled address and calldata.
Owner-only initializer computing _minSale/_maxSale with unchecked multiplication and setting _saleNum.
Owner-only loop that multiplies _value by array length unchecked and credits balances in a loop.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist slot.
Payable constructor minting totalSupply to deployer, setting owner, and granting infinite allowance to UNI router.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation used by ensure for whitelisting.
Private owner address; sole access-control principal for privileged functions.
Public balanceOf mapping mutated without SafeMath in transferFrom/batchSend/constructor.
Public nested allowance mapping written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Private per-address sale counter incremented on every transferFrom.
Private whitelist mapping used by ensure to bypass sale conditions.
Private maximum number of sales per address enforced in condition.
Private minimum transfer value enforced in condition; set by init.
Private maximum transfer value enforced in condition; set by init.
Whitelisted trading address that bypasses sale restrictions in ensure.
Public total supply set in constructor with unchecked multiplication.
Public constant decimals (18) used for scaling in init.
Public token name assigned in constructor.
Public token symbol assigned in constructor.
Constant Uniswap router address granted infinite allowance.
msg.sender - caller-controlled address used for owner checks, allowance spending and balance mutations.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Unchecked balance and allowance subtractions/additions in transferFrom (arithmetic risk).
Unchecked total = _value * _tos.length multiplication in batchSend (overflow risk).

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the _from argument into transfer, which forwards it to transferFrom.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
msg.sender is compared to _from to decide whether allowance must be spent.
transferFrom calls ensure before mutating balances.
balance and allowance updates in transferFrom use unchecked + and - instead of SafeMath.
balanceOf mapping is decremented/incremented without SafeMath in transferFrom.
allowance mapping is decremented with unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
_onSaleNum[_from] is incremented on every transferFrom call.
ensure falls through to condition when the sender is not whitelisted.
owner is compared against _from/_to to bypass the sale condition entirely.
canSale[_from] whitelist is read to bypass the sale condition.
tradeAddress is compared against _from to bypass the sale condition.
ensure derives the Uniswap UNI pair address by calling pairFor.
condition reads _saleNum to limit the number of sales per address.
condition reads _minSale to reject values below the minimum.
condition reads _maxSale to reject values above the maximum.
condition compares _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
msg.sender is the implicit owner key when approve writes the allowance mapping.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing.
delegate performs an arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address and calldata.
init requires msg.sender == owner before configuring sale parameters.
_minSale is computed with an unchecked multiplication in init.
_maxSale is computed with an unchecked multiplication in init.
_saleNum is assigned from the saleNum parameter in init.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before distributing tokens.
total = _value * _tos.length is computed without overflow protection.
balanceOf is mutated in the batchSend loop with unchecked arithmetic.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist state variable.
constructor sets owner from the deploying msg.sender.
constructor assigns the owner state variable.
totalSupply is minted via unchecked _supply * 10**decimals multiplication.
constructor assigns the entire initial balance to the deployer.
constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the UNI router address.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only used to forward the transfer recipient into transferFrom.
_value is only used to forward the transfer amount into transferFrom.
_from parameter is consumed by allowance, ensure and balance logic inside transferFrom.
_to parameter is consumed by the balance credit inside transferFrom.
_value parameter drives allowance spending and unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
_from is the whitelist/condition selector inside ensure.
_to is compared against owner inside ensure.
_value is forwarded to condition inside ensure.
_spender is used as the allowance mapping key in approve.
_value is stored as the approved allowance in approve.
_from selects the _onSaleNum counter checked in condition.
_value is compared to _minSale and _maxSale in condition.
address a is the target of the unsafe delegatecall.
bytes b is the calldata of the unsafe delegatecall.
saleNum is written into the _saleNum state variable.
token is scaled into _minSale with unchecked multiplication.
maxToken is scaled into _maxSale with unchecked multiplication.
_tos length multiplies into the unchecked total and drives the distribution loop.
_value is multiplied unchecked by array length to form total.
addr is stored into the tradeAddress state variable.
_name is assigned to the name state variable.
_symbol is assigned to the symbol state variable.
_supply drives the unchecked totalSupply mint in the constructor.
_UNI is a short-lived pair address local used only for the whitelist comparison.
total is the intermediate result of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
i is only the loop counter of the batchSend distribution loop.
_to is a loop-local alias of _tos[i] used for the balance credit.
